investigation_notes.Description: Vitalis Healthcare logo detected on the domain vitalis-care-verification.net, which appears to be a newly registered site hosting a page that asks for personal information. The domain resolves to IP 185.212.131.54 and is only 1 day old, registered with Hostinger, indicating a high-risk, potentially fraudulent hosting setup. While the IP reputation shows no abuse flag, the combination of brand impersonation, recent domain creation, and a credential-collection page suggests a high-risk phishing scenario requiring escalation.
